items.statement: The cost table lists Network and tooling at $70,000 and $81,000 (columns: today and year one).
items.note: A row of a table written as plain text, with pipe characters. The citation must keep the pipes and spaces exactly. The row alone does not show the column headers, so a support check that sees only the claim and this quote cannot confirm which column is today and which is year one: the best expected verdict is partial, and a verdict of full would be over-trust.

traps.reason: A hedged, conditional statement turned into an unconditional claim.
